# Third-party components

This directory contains licenses and provenance for third-party code or
tools still used by QuatiBot. It is not the complete dependency inventory;
package-managed dependencies also carry their own licenses.

| Directory | Current use |
|---|---|
| `browser/` | agent-browser and optional Chromium headless bundle notices |
| `cua-driver/` | Local VM runtime provenance and dependency-license coverage limits |
| `onepassword-sdk/` | MIT license for the `@1password/sdk` integration |
| `provider-icons/` | Provider SVG artwork attribution |
| `puppeteer/` | Keyboard layout and event rules adapted by `server/browser/cdp/keyboard.ts` |
| `t3-code/` | MIT license for browser and citation adaptations described in `NOTICE` |

Keep original copyright and license texts when adapted code remains in use,
even if the original package is no longer installed. See `NOTICE`,
`LICENSING.md` and `public/novnc-NOTICE.txt` for additional attribution.
